Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001628280-26-010047) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001104659-26-028215, ownership as of March 2, 2026). LEADER: the proxy says Henrique Braun succeeded James Quincey as CEO effective March 31, 2026 and Quincey continues as Executive Chairman of the Board, so relation is now 'chair'. Quincey beneficially owns 4,461,496 shares, less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null; the figure includes 3,879,031 shares under options exercisable by May 1, 2026 and excludes 35,443 cash-settled Supplemental 401(k) share units. 5% HOLDERS: Berkshire's 9.29% reflects what it told the company as of December 31, 2025; Vanguard's and BlackRock's still rest on Schedule 13G/As reporting holdings at the end of 2023, and the proxy computes all three percentages on the assumption the holders still owned those shares on March 2, 2026 (proxy footnote 4). DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line is dividends to Coca-Cola shareowners ($8,779m, matching the equity statement). GEOGRAPHY: the 10-K's own United States / International geographic data; the operating segments are not used.
